name: JARVIS AI Assistant
summary: An independent Python assistant with a web-based control panel, voice features, AI-provider integrations, and optional phone/system automation.

license.verification: README declares MIT; verify LICENSE file at pinned revision

macOS.minimum: upstream README lists Windows 10/11 as primary support
macOS.verification: macOS port and dependency test required

runtime.minimum: 3.7+ per upstream README; current compatible version must be tested

dependencies.notes: native audio build/device compatibility must be tested on macOS
large dependency; verify Apple Silicon wheel and memory impact

install.reason: Upstream quick installer is install.bat for Windows; macOS installation path must be tested and adapted safely.

uiPolicy: Preserve and launch the upstream UI; JARVIS provides management and status only.

cost.providers: Groq and Gemini require provider credentials; API pricing/free tiers are external and can change
